# giscus presentation reference

These files come from [giscus](https://github.com/giscus/giscus) commit `3d6430237108ca4ee3eb6a1a20595201c09c72d5`, fetched on September 26, 2026. The MIT license is in [../LICENSE](../LICENSE).

The components guide presentation review and stylesheet utility discovery. Their React and network code is not bundled. The build compiles the styles with Tailwind and scopes them for native embedding.
